reason: WaitingFor::ChooseGiftRecipient gains a purpose (CastOpponentChoicePurpose: Gift or EffectCost) so an effect-cost recipient prompt such as Invigorate's is not presented as a gift promise. An older full-game or P2P peer would read an EffectCost prompt as a Gift. PendingCast also gains deferred_life_gain_cost, the life-gain cost carried to the payment commit, which an older peer would drop.
